description.text: Providing flexible schooling system, study duration for doctor program is 3-4 years.

duration.text: The Mechanical Design and Theory at Southwest Jiaotong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Master's degree holder with good health 2.HSK Band 6 or above 3.Pass written exam on a major subject or interview
